'''The Bunch of Grapes''' is an inn in the [[Foregate]] in [[Cairhien]], located just beyond the [[Cairhien (city)|Jangai Gate]]. {{ref/book|2|25}} It is owned by [[Zera]]. {{ref/book|2|26}}

==Appearance==

"It was an old three-story structure, wooden and rickety, but the common room was clean and full of people." {{ref/book|2|26}}

==Activites==

Rand went to The Bunch of Grapes to return [[Thom]]'s flute. Later, [[Dena]] was murdered there. {{ref/book|2|34}} The inn was likely destroyed when the Foregate burned.
